text:
[Council File 26-1626; CD 14]
Motion (Jurado - Lee) relative to a Use Agreement for the City-owned Parking Lot No. 7 located at 140 Judge John Aiso Street in Little Tokyo that formalizes the long-standing use by the Little Tokyo Service Center and other adjacent businesses of said Lot; and, related matters.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
